notes.title: The Banana Update 1.05
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791568/213adb231eddb415bcb50c6626068b9b0146e833.jpg[/img] 

Added banana level, an homage to the notorious banana game. It doesn’t matter if it’s goood or bad it’s REAL, it EXISTS, the attention from players and robots have made it powerful, they cannot take that power back and that power is real. What are you going to make more powerful, where are you giving your attention today? (I hope it’s Seven Second Summer Camp!)
